# L4ZY menu plan for the settings assistant. GENERATED by distrib/tools/menus_plan.py
# from data/menus.cfg and traduction.cfg at every release: do not edit by hand.
# "## page | title | route" starts a page; the route starts at the main menu (Escape).
# "== name" starts a section (its title in the page). Lines are numbered top to bottom.
# On one line, " | " = side by side, left to right; "[ a / b ]" = a column, top to bottom.
# {if ...} = only shown when the condition holds. "> page X" = the button opens page X.
# checkbox / choice (radio buttons, "label"=value, side by side unless "one under the other") / slider / field /
# flag / key / colours: the setting follows. "note:" = grey hint line, "status:" = coloured message.
# Not resolved: loops over a count known only in game are shown once ("repeated");
# labels computed in game show as <function>.

# --- settings pages (Options) ---

## importsettings | Import settings | Options > Import settings from another client

3. {if importsrccount() = 0} note: No other client found in My Games.

5. button "<if (= $importsel -1) [result "> "] [result ""]>Another folder (type it below)" : importsel = -1
6. field importdir (Enter runs importsel = -1)
7. note: Example: C:\Games\Sauerbraten (the folder that holds config.cfg)
8. {if importsel >= -1 and importsel = -1} note: From: <guifieldtext importdir>
9. {if importsel >= -1 and not (importsel = -1)} note: From: <importsrcfolder $importsel>
10. {if importsel >= -1} button "<if (importrestartable) [result "Import and restart"] [result "Import at next start"]>" : importsettingsfrom $importsel (guifieldtext i...
11. {if not (importsel >= -1)} note: Pick a client above.
12. note: Your current settings are kept as config.cfg.before-import.bak
13. {if not (strcmp(importlastresult() ))} note: Last time: <importlastresult>

10. {if Windows HDR on for this screen} note: Windows HDR is on for this screen: gamma is not applied (it can blank an HDR screen).

## gfx | Graphics | Options > Graphics
== Lighting
1. note: Classic: original Sauerbraten lighting, no ray-tracing GPU needed. Ray tracing: RT lights, sun and sky.
2. choice hwrt: "Classic (no RT)"=0, "Ray tracing"=1
3. {if hwrtraison() != ""} status: <hwrtraison>
4. {if hwrtraison() != ""} note: It needs a graphics card with hardware ray tracing and an up-to-date graphics driver.
5. {if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1) and RT lighting running} status: Ray-traced lighting is running.
6. {if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1) and not (RT lighting running)} status: Ray tracing chosen, but RT lighting is not running yet (no map loaded, or it failed: see console).
7. note: Classic lighting only. Slightly darker corners and wall bases; players are never darkened.
8. "Ambient Occlusion" choice gtao: "Off"=0, "Low"=1, "High"=2
9. {if gtao on and RT lighting running} note: Ambient Occlusion is not used with ray tracing: RT already traces the sky light.
== Display output
1. note: Native HDR sends a real HDR picture to an HDR screen. Windows HDR must already be on (it is never changed h...
2. choice hdroutpref: "Automatic"=-1, "SDR"=0, "Native HDR"=1
3. {if "Automatic" chosen (hdroutpref -1)} note: Automatic: Native HDR if Windows HDR is on and supported, otherwise SDR.
4. {if Native HDR in use} status: In use: Native HDR
5. {if not (Native HDR in use) and HDR preview in use} status: In use: HDR preview shown in SDR (diagnostic, not native HDR)
6. {if not (Native HDR in use) and not (HDR preview in use)} text "In use: SDR"
7. {if hdroutpref != 0 and hdroutdispo() = 0} note: <hdroutraison>
== HDR calibration
1. note: Used by Native HDR only. Kept across maps, outputs, anti-aliasing and lighting.
2. text "Exposure: <hwrthdrexp> EV (default 0)" (computed)
3. button "-0.5" : hdroutexpstep -0.5 | button "-0.1" : hdroutexpstep -0.1 | button "+0.1" : hdroutexpstep 0.1 | button "+0.5" : hdroutexpstep 0.5 | button "Reset" : hwrthdrexp 0
4. slider "Reference white: <hdroutref> nits (default 80)" hdroutref
5. text "<hdroutpeaklabel>"
6. choice hdroutmax: "Automatic peak"=0 | {if "Automatic peak" chosen (hdroutmax 0)} button "Manual peak" : hdroutmax (max 400 (hdroutpeakauto)) | {if not ("Automatic peak" chosen (hdroutmax 0))} (button "-100" : hdroutmax (max 100 (- $hdroutmax 100)) | button "+100" : hdroutmax (min 10000 (+ $hdroutmax 100)))
7. text "<hdrouthudlabel>"
8. choice hdrouthud: "HUD follows reference white"=0 | {if "HUD follows reference white" chosen (hdrouthud 0)} button "Custom HUD brightness" : hdrouthud (max 40 $hdroutref)
9. {if hdrouthud > 0} slider hdrouthud
== Look
1. checkbox "Temporal AA" looktaa | checkbox "My Shadow (Sun)" lookselfshadow
2. {if DLSS/FSR built in and hwrtngxmodeapplied() != 0} note: Temporal AA / FXAA unused while DLAA, DLSS or FSR is on. They return on Native.
3. {if Native HDR in use} note: Temporal AA is not applied in Native HDR.
4. checkbox "Teleport light" hwrtteleportlight | checkbox "Jumppad light" hwrtjumppadlight | checkbox "Smoke shadows" hwrtsmokeshadow
5. {if "Smoke shadows" ticked (hwrtsmokeshadow)} note: Smoke shadow density (percent, default: 100):
6. {if "Smoke shadows" ticked (hwrtsmokeshadow)} slider hwrtsmokeshadowdensity
7. note: Uncheck my shadow if it looks dirty or ugly indoors.
== Anti-Aliasing {only if DLSS/FSR built in}
1. note: Native, NVIDIA DLAA / DLSS, or AMD FSR. Quality uses more internal pixels than Performance.
2. choice hwrtngxmode: "Native"=0, "DLAA"=1, "DLSS Quality"=2, "DLSS Balanced"=3, "DLSS Performance"=4
3. {if FSR built in} choice hwrtngxmode: "FSR Native"=5, "FSR Quality"=6, "FSR Balanced"=7, "FSR Performance"=8
4. {if FSR built in and hwrtdlssraison() != ""} status: <hwrtdlssraison>
5. {if FSR built in and hwrtfsrraison() != ""} status: <hwrtfsrraison>
6. {if FSR built in and hwrtngxmode >= 6 and hwrtfsrraison() = ""} note: FSR sharpening after upscaling (0 = off, 10 = like DLSS):
7. {if FSR built in and hwrtngxmode >= 6 and hwrtfsrraison() = ""} slider hwrtfsrsharpness
8. {if hwrtngxfallback() = 1} status: Using Native: <AA_modename $hwrtngxmode> did not start. Your choice is kept.
9. {if hwrtngxfallback() = 1 and hwrtngxreason() != ""} note: <hwrtngxreason>
== RT Sky Denoise {only if NRD built in}
1. note: Ray tracing only. Filters the ray-traced sky light. NRD works with Native, DLSS and FSR.
2. choice hwrtnrd: "Sauer filter"=0, "NRD"=1
3. {if hwrtnrdfallback() = 1 and RT lighting running} status: Using the Sauer filter — NRD unavailable.
== RT Reflections {only if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)}
1. note: Ray tracing only. Sharp ray-traced reflections on water and on surfaces the map made reflective.
2. choice hwrtreflections: "Off"=0, "On"=1
== RT Specular {only if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)}
1. note: Ray tracing only. Shine of the lamps and the sun on glossy surfaces, as in classic lighting.
2. choice hwrtspecular: "Off"=0, "On"=1
== RT Textures {only if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)}
1. note: Ray tracing only. Smooths small textures seen up close. Lanczos: a little sharper.
2. "Upscaling" choice hwrtdiffupscale: "Bicubic"=2, "Lanczos"=3, "Nearest"=0
3. note: Distant textures: Stable shimmers less in motion, Sharper keeps a little more detail.
4. "Distance detail" choice hwrtdiffmipbias: "Stable"=0, "Sharper"=-0.5
== RT Normals {only if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)}
1. note: Ray tracing only. Smooths lighting across faceted floors and walls, like classic lighting.
2. choice hwrtsmoothnormals: "Off"=0, "On"=1
== RT Weapon Lights {only if "Ray tracing" chosen (hwrt 1)}
1. note: Ray tracing only. Muzzle flashes, rockets, grenades and explosions light the scene.
2. choice hwrtdynlights: "Off"=0, "On"=1
== Deaths
1. checkbox "Blood" blood
2. checkbox "Ragdoll Deaths" ragdoll | {if "Ragdoll Deaths" ticked (ragdoll)} checkbox "Keep After Respawn" ragdollmillis on=10000 | checkbox "Hide Dead Players" hidedead
3. slider "Ragdoll Velocity Multiplier" deadpush
== Players
1. checkbox "Fullbright Player Models" fullbrightmodels on=60 | {if "Fullbright Player Models" ticked (fullbrightmodels)} choice fullbrightmodels: "Subtle"=60, "Bright"=100, "Overbright"=150, "Max"=200
2. checkbox "Force Matching Player Models" forceplayermodels | checkbox "Always Use Team Skins" teamskins
== Advanced
1. text "Performance Key: Fast, Moderate, Slow and Pretty"
2. "Shaders" choice shaderdetail: "Low Detail"=1, "High Detail"=3
3. text "Water" | checkbox "Refraction" waterrefract | checkbox "Reflection" waterreflect | checkbox "Caustics" caustics | checkbox "Animation" vertwater
4. text "Waterfalls" | checkbox "Refraction" waterfallrefract | checkbox "Reflection" waterfallenv
5. text "Soft Shadows" | checkbox "On" shadowmap | {if shadowmap on} choice shadowmapsize: "Medium Quality"=9, "High Quality"=10 | {if not (shadowmap on)} checkbox "Blob Shadows" blobs
6. text "Glare" | checkbox "On" glare | {if glare on} choice glarepreset: "Subtle"=1, "Glowy"=2, "Soft"=3, "Intense"=4
7. text "Motion Blur" | checkbox "On" motionblur | {if motionblur on} choice motionblurscale: "Subtle"=0.5, "Moderate"=0.65, "Intense"=0.8
8. text "Grass" | checkbox "On" grass | {if grass on} choice grassdist: "Quick Fade"=128, "Moderate Fade"=256, "Slow Fade"=512
9. text "Dynamic Lights" | checkbox "On" maxdynlights on=3 | {if maxdynlights on} choice maxdynlights: "Medium Quality"=3, "High Quality"=5
10. text "Soft Particles" | checkbox "On" depthfx | {if depthfx on} choice depthfxsize: "Low Quality"=7, "Medium Quality"=10, "High Quality"=12
11. text "Glass Reflection" | checkbox "On" glassenv
12. text "Decals" | checkbox "On" decals | {if decals on} choice decalfade: "Quick Fade"=10000, "Slow Fade"=60000
13. "Textures" choice maxtexsize: "Low Quality"=256, "Medium Quality"=512, "High Quality"=0
14. text "Models" | checkbox "Reflection" envmapmodels | checkbox "Bump Map" bumpmodels

## audio | Sound | Options > Sound
== (top)
1. slider "Master Volume" soundvol
2. slider "Music Volume" musicvol
3. checkbox "Hit Sound" hitsound
4. note: Ping when you hit someone. Volume is Mix → Hits.
== 3D Sound
1. note: Headphones: hear whether a sound is ahead or behind, above or below (Steam Audio HRTF, sets 44100 Hz).
2. note: Speakers: usual left/right sound. Your own sounds, menus, announcements and music are never changed.
3. choice son3d: "Off"=0, "Headphones (HRTF)"=1, "Speakers"=2
4. checkbox "Occlusion: walls muffle sounds (needs Headphones or Speakers)" son3docclusion
5. {if son3d on and son3deffectif() = 0} status: 3D sound unavailable: <son3derreur>
== Mix
1. note: 100 = normal. 0 = mute. 200 = twice as loud.

3. slider "Hits (hit ping)" mixhits

5. text "<tmodellabel $arg1>" | button "<tmodelbtn $arg1>" : concat tmodelclick small | button "Delete" : concat tmodeldelete small
6. text "<tmodellabel $arg1>" | button "<tmodelbtn $arg1>" : concat tmodelclick normal | button "Delete" : concat tmodeldelete normal
7. text "<tmodellabel $arg1>" | button "<tmodelbtn $arg1>" : concat tmodelclick large | button "Delete" : concat tmodeldelete large
8. note: Large needs ~12 GB VRAM. Drop a custom .gguf here:
9. button "Open custom model folder" : openfolder models

== Examples
1. text "Few-shot examples: more = more work for the AI (slower)"
2. note: Exact translation: this phrase only, does not slow the AI.
3. note: Keep as many as you want. = means leave untranslated.
4. note: /tfix uses the same choice as this page.
5. text "<texamplestatus>"
6. text "Language"
7. button "English" : concat texamplesetlang en | button "French" : concat texamplesetlang fr | button "German" : concat texamplesetlang de | button "Spanish" : concat texamplesetlang es | button "Russian" : concat texamplesetlang ru
8. button "Portuguese" : concat texamplesetlang pt | button "Italian" : concat texamplesetlang it | button "Polish" : concat texamplesetlang pl | button "Dutch" : concat texamplesetlang nl | button "Swedish" : concat texamplesetlang sv
9. field "Other" texamplelang (Enter runs texamplerefresh)
10. "Direction" choice texampledir: "Incoming Chat"=0, "What I Send"=1
11. "Save As" choice texamplekind: "Exact Translation"=0, "Few-Shot Example"=1
12. {if "I Am a Woman" ticked (translatefemme)} note: I Am a Woman is on: feminine examples are included
13. {if not ("I Am a Woman" ticked (translatefemme))} note: I Am a Woman is off: feminine-only examples stay hidden
14. field "Original Phrase" texamplesrc
15. field "How It Should Read" texampledst
16. button "Save" : texamplesave | button "Forget This Original" : texampleforgetsrc | button "Reload List" : texamplerefresh
17. {if texamplecount on and repeated for each i (count known in game: <texamplecount>)} (text "<texampleline $i>" | button "Edit" : concat texampleload <i> | button "Forget" : concat texampleforget <i>)
18. {if not (texamplecount on)} note: No examples in this list yet
== Commands
1. note: /say always sends as typed
2. note: /tsay always uses I Send In
3. note: /trep replies in the last player's language
4. note: /to name hello : @name, follows Auto-Translate. Tab completes
5. note: /sayto name hello : @name, as typed
6. note: /tsayto name hello : @name, I Send In
7. note: /trepto name hello : @name, that player's language
8. note: /tfix better : last chat line was wrong (exact or example, see Examples)
9. note: /tfixout better : last line you sent was wrong
10. note: /tretry or F9 : last chat, MOTD or [INFO] (not assists)
11. note: /tretry 12 : retranslate F10 line 12 (numbers on the left)
12. text "/tsayde hello"
13. note: Replace de with a language code
14. text "/tsaytde hello"
15. note: Same codes, team chat
16. text "/toteam /saytoteam /tsaytoteam /treptoteam"
17. note: Same as /to /sayto /tsayto /trepto, team chat
18. text "/trepteam same as /trep, team chat"
